title: Senior Full-stack Engineer (Back-end Architecture)
description:
Hey there! 👋

 

We're looking for an expert full-stack React/Node.js engineer with experience in building AI tools to join our growing team! You would be joining a truly fast-growing team and working on a product that is already having a significant impact in the United States. 

 

Although this position expects you to be a full-stack engineer, your focus will be mostly on the back-end infrastructure and the optimization of the existing product architecture (80% back, 20% front).

 

Our preferred candidate will have: 🦄

 

  • Strong experience with building scalable back-end infrastructure;
  • Working with high-load systems;
  • Optimizing systems with relational databases (PostgreSQL);
  • Extensive experience with Elasticsearch;
  • Clear demonstration of leadership initiatives in optimizing & scaling cloud infrastructure;

 

We also expect from you the following: 🎯

 

  • English: Advanced (C1+, initial screening is conducted in English);
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or similar;
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and analytical skills;
  • 5+ years of writing commercial React.js and Node.js apps;
  • Extensive experience with SQL-based databases;
  • Extensive experience with Amazon Web Services;
  • Understanding of LLMs and their application to building web applications;

 

What’s in it for you: 🌴

 

Professional Growth & Lifestyle:

 

- Remote work and flexible working hours (our team is 100% remote);

- Opportunity to join an international team of a fast-scaling startup;

- Leadership initiatives;

 

Benefits:

 

- Annual vacation: 20 business days (100% compensation)

- Annual sick leave: 10 business days (100% compensation)

- Competitive compensation.

 

Please, feel free to reach out if you have any questions!

 

Best regards,

Universium Team ❤️
